result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: a persistent loading spinner remains visible over an already loaded restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image under 'Popular right now', even though the image and card content have already finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator state is properly cleared and hidden once the card image finishes rendering or the refresh operation completes.
